title: Make repeated SRD feature choices advancement-level aware
description:
Combined vk23 audit follow-up.

Repeated features such as Ability Score Improvement are source-correctly represented as a feature whose source prose starts at the first level where it appears, while class advancement grants the same feature at later levels.

Example:
- Fighter has one Ability Score Improvement feature with source level metadata around level 4.
- Fighter progression grants ASI at levels 4, 6, 8, 12, 14, 16, and 19.

This is source-faithful, but deterministic level-up tooling must instantiate the choice using the class advancement row level, not only the static feature choice level. Otherwise repeated ASI choices can be mis-leveled or collapsed.

Acceptance criteria:
- Define the contract for repeated feature choice instantiation:
  - feature source level identifies where the feature prose originates
  - advancement grant level identifies the level at which a choice instance is available
- Ensure character-creation/level-up consumers can derive separate choice instances for repeated grants.
- Add regression coverage for Fighter ASI levels, including non-4 ASI grants such as levels 6 and 14.
- Audit other repeated features with choices and ensure the same contract holds.
- Document the distinction between feature source metadata and advancement instance metadata.
close_reason: Added repeatedFeatureChoices.ts: separates feature source level from advancement grant level, derives one choice instance per grant level. Mystic Arcanum's already-correct per-level entries are not duplicated. Regression coverage for Fighter ASI (incl. levels 6/14), Channel Divinity, Expertise, Metamagic against the real pack
